snippet.title: The most absurd RPG this year. 100% human-made chaos. No AI. 🎨
snippet.description:
An indie game from China! Welcome to the absurd world of "BigWall: WildKnight". Swap heads, wield bizarre weapons, and summon trains with a plunger. 🚂🍎

🎮 Play the Demo for FREE on Steam Next Fest: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4351460/

#shorts #indiegame #gaming #steamnextfest #rpg
